info.name: Feature API — Project Features Showcase
info.description:
API testing collection for the Project Features Showcase.

## Quick Start
1. Set `base_url`, `admin_secret`, and `test_project_id` in the **Variables** tab
2. Run **TC-3.1** (Create Feature - Minimal) → auto-saves `test_feature_id`
3. Run **TC-7.1** (Upload Media - JPEG) → auto-saves `test_media_id`
4. Run remaining tests in order

## Variable Reference
- `base_url` — Next.js dev server (default: http://localhost:3000)
- `admin_secret` — Value of ADMIN_SECRET_KEY from .env
- `test_project_id` — UUID of an existing project (**set manually**)
- `test_feature_id` — Auto-saved by TC-3.1
- `test_media_id` — Auto-saved by TC-7.1

## Media Upload Notes
For file upload tests (TC-7.x), attach real image files in the formdata 'file' field within Postman.
Prepare test files: image.jpg, image.png, document.pdf, and a file >10MB.
